threads.label: Iran airline sanctions and aviation isolation
threads.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced foreign companies servicing Iranian airlines face US secondary sanctions from Wednesday. Turkish Airlines told Iran International it has suspended all Iran flights until at least March 2027, with Iraq also moving to halt Iranian carriers.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz blockade and tanker incident
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS Rafael Peralta continues enforcing the US blockade against Iran, with 110 commercial vessels redirected as of 21 September. UKMTO reported an LPG carrier struck by 'unknown projectiles' in the Strait of Hormuz with no crew injuries, per a Defa Press post.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire-line incident and IDF response
threads.summary: The IDF said an unmanned engineering vehicle was hit by a Hamas explosive device on the Israeli side of the Yellow Line in northern Gaza, causing no injuries, and it struck Hamas infrastructure in response. IRIB and Jerusalem Post also carried reports of the vehicle explosion and subsequent strikes.

threads.label: Iran-US mediation signals and IRGC threats
threads.summary: Qatar's foreign ministry spokesman said Doha is working to facilitate even a short-term agreement between Tehran and Washington, per a Defa Press post. IRGC spokesperson Hossein Mohibi told Fars News the Guards were ready to change the 'weaponry and geography of the war' if the US launches new attacks.

threads.label: Sacred Defence Week messaging cycle
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran a heavy cycle of Sacred Defence Week content, including an IRGC statement that America and Israel 'must yield to a region free of their filthy presence' and remarks by Deputy Commander Izadi on 'strategic patience'. Defa Press announced a motorcyclist special units parade of IRGC ground forces for the following afternoon.

events.title_en: Guterres: The Security Council is paralysed. Antonio Guterres, Secretary-General of the United Nations, whilst expressing regret at the failed efforts of the Security Council to establish a ceasefire in Gaza, condemned the divisions and rifts that have paralysed this global body. Guterres' remarks came two days after the United States vetoed a UN Security Council resolution calling for a ceasefire in Gaza.

events.title_en: Exhibition of Minab children held opposite the United Nations headquarters in Geneva. The Minab Children's Exhibition, thanks to the efforts of two Iranian civil activists residing in Geneva, was set up opposite the headquarters of the United Nations in Geneva. This exhibition started on Saturday in Nations Square (Place des Nations), opposite the main entrance of the UN headquarters and adjacent to the famous 'broken chair' of Geneva – a recognisable symbol of the consequences of war and violence against civilians – and will continue until Tuesday, 31 Shahrivar. In this exhibition, images of the dimensions of this human tragedy, paintings by the martyred children of Minab, as well as several school bags and a number of objects left behind by them are on display for diplomats, civilian activists and visitors from all over the world. A number of Iranian civil activists and human rights defenders who are residents of Geneva and Switzerland participated in the opening of this exhibition.
